facts.raw_span: a 2-year history of a mildly pruritic, erythematous, and gradually enlarging lesion on the proximal portion of his left calf
the lesion had appeared without an identifiable cause
no improvement with topical corticosteroids and antifungals for the previous 2 months
ill-defined, nonindurated, erythematous-violaceous plaque that was slightly raised but with an atrophic appearance
Band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis with no grenz zone
Round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells
No hemosiderin deposits found with Perls Prussian blue stain
Vascular channel endothelial cells were positive for CD34 and CD31 but negative for D2-40
Ill-defined, erythematous-violaceous plaque with an atrophic appearance
Band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis with no grenz zone (hematoxylin-eosin)
Round vascular channels lined by a single layer of endothelial cells without atypia (hematoxylin-eosin)
CD34 immunostaining labels endothelial cells

concepts.why: The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 are characteristic of Kaposi's Sarcoma.

The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 are also characteristic of Angiosarcoma.
The presence of an ill-defined, erythematous-violaceous plaque with an atrophic appearance is consistent with Hemangioma.
The presence of an ill-defined, erythematous-violaceous plaque with an atrophic appearance is also consistent with Pyogenic Granuloma.
The presence of a gradually enlarging lesion with no improvement with topical corticosteroids and antifungals is consistent with Dermatofibroma.

The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 are not characteristic of Squamous Cell Carcinoma, but it is a possible differential diagnosis.

The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 are not characteristic of Basal Cell Carcinoma, but it is a possible differential diagnosis.

The presence of band-like vascular proliferation in the upper dermis, round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells, and positivity for CD34 and CD31 are not characteristic of Merkel Cell Carcinoma, but it is a possible differential diagnosis.
The presence of round vascular spaces lined by a single layer of endothelial cells and positive CD34 immunostaining labels endothelial cells is consistent with a hemangioma.
